ThingDef.label: Dean's worn leather jacket
ThingDef.description: A scuffed dark-brown cowhide car coat with faded seams, brass snaps, and deep pockets lined with rock-salt pouches and a hidden demon-trap charm. Part of the Older Brother set.

ThingDef.label: Dean's sawed-off double-barrel
ThingDef.description: A short-barreled 12-gauge double-barrel shotgun with a dark walnut stock, kept in the trunk of a '67 Impala and loaded with coarse rock-salt shells that stagger and stun demons and anomalies at close range. Part of the Older Brother set.

ThingDef.label: Sam's layered hunter parka
ThingDef.description: A practical olive canvas field jacket worn over a plaid flannel shirt and dark hoodie, with inner pockets stuffed with lore notebooks and Enochian spell slips.

ThingDef.label: Preston Garvey's colonial hat
ThingDef.description: A wide-brimmed tan felt colonial hat with one side pinned up by a tarnished brass Minutemen badge. A symbol of hope for struggling settlements.

ThingDef.label: Bobby Singer's trucker cap
ThingDef.description: A faded navy-blue mesh trucker cap stained with motor oil and sweat, worn by the gruffest lorekeeper in the hunter network.

ThingDef.label: Castiel's rumpled trenchcoat
ThingDef.description: A battered beige trenchcoat worn over a dark suit and crooked blue tie, subtly scorched along the hems by celestial fire and tailored with reinforced back slits for angelic wings. Can only be worn by Angels. Part of the Rebel Seraph set.

ThingDef.label: Castiel's angel blade
ThingDef.description: A sleek, triangular silver-steel stiletto carried inside the sleeve of a rebel angel. Forged in Heaven, it slays regular demons and angels in a single thrust, while inflicting heavy damage against powerful named heroes. Part of the Rebel Seraph set.

ThingDef.label: Michael's radiant cuirass
ThingDef.description: Ornate white-gold commander armor etched with blazing celestial runes, leaving open vents along the shoulder blades for archangel wings. Can only be worn by Angels.

ThingDef.label: Lucifer's immaculate white suit
ThingDef.description: A razor-sharp white tailored suit with subtle silver pinstripes, radiating unsettling charisma and cold, theatrical arrogance.

ThingDef.label: Crowley's King of Hell suit
ThingDef.description: A bespoke charcoal-black Savile Row suit with a crimson pocket square and hidden sigil stitching. Built for negotiating souls in style.

ThingDef.label: Ruby's demon-killing knife
ThingDef.description: An ancient curved hunting dagger with a stag-horn handle and a blade covered in worn, arcane engravings. One deep strike destroys regular demons permanently, while dealing heavy damage to named demon heroes.

ThingDef.label: Maxson's Elder battlecoat
ThingDef.description: A heavy sheepskin-lined brown leather bomber trenchcoat worn over Brotherhood combat fatigues, emblazoned with the Elder's steel crest.

ThingDef.label: Paladin Danse's recon hood
ThingDef.description: A tight olive-drab ballistic skullcap with padded ear cups and a chin strap, designed to cushion the head inside heavy T-60 helmets.

ThingDef.label: Casdin's Outcast command helmet
ThingDef.description: A matte-black T-45d power armor helmet painted with a crimson stripe across the brow and upgraded target-acquisition optics.

ThingDef.label: Colonel Autumn's leather greatcoat
ThingDef.description: A heavy dark-slate leather command greatcoat with red piping, brass buttons, and concealed ballistic mesh lining.

ThingDef.label: Father's Director lab coat
ThingDef.description: An immaculate white synthetic coat with subtle silver trim, worn by the supreme Director of the Institute.

ThingDef.label: Kellogg's armored mercenary outfit
ThingDef.description: A rugged brown leather jacket with a single bolted metal shoulder pauldron and reinforced cybernetic interface straps. Part of the Institute Mercenary set.

ThingDef.label: Kellogg's .44 revolver
ThingDef.description: A heavy nickel-plated .44 magnum revolver with a dark wood grip and hair-trigger mechanism, infamous across the wasteland. Part of the Institute Mercenary set.

ThingDef.label: Desdemona's ballistic fatigues
ThingDef.description: A dark olive-grey field jacket interwoven with dense ballistic weave and lined with hidden pockets for cipher keys and synth holotapes.

ThingDef.label: Deacon's undercover shades
ThingDef.description: Classic black-framed tinted sunglasses paired with a subtle micro-transceiver earpiece. Helps the wearer keep a stone-cold poker face.

ThingDef.label: Captain Wes's command coat
ThingDef.description: A dark olive mercenary greatcoat layered over reinforced combat armor plates, marked with silver captain bars and the Gunners' skull emblem.

ThingDef.label: Dr. Braun's simulation suit
ThingDef.description: A spotless pre-war cream-white suit fitted with gold cufflinks and neural-interface sensors hidden beneath the collar.

ThingDef.label: Dr. Hess's arcane monocle
ThingDef.description: A gold-rimmed crystal monocle etched with microscopic Enochian sigils, allowing the wearer to read faint magical residues and spot hidden illusions.

ThingDef.label: Arthur Ketch's bespoke assassin suit
ThingDef.description: A razor-tailored charcoal British suit lined with flexible ballistic mesh and concealed holsters for enchanted blades and pistols.

ThingDef.label: Hancock's red frock coat
ThingDef.description: A weathered, gold-trimmed crimson colonial frock coat worn with a matching tricorn hat, symbolizing Goodneighbor's fierce independence.

ThingDef.label: Silver Shroud trenchcoat & fedora
ThingDef.description: A dramatic silver-grey trenchcoat and matching wide-brimmed fedora modeled after a pre-war radio vigilante, reinforced with modern ballistic padding.

ThingDef.label: Fawkes's torn Vault 87 jumpsuit
ThingDef.description: A heavily patched, oversized blue-and-yellow Vault 87 jumpsuit reinforced with leather straps and steel plates to fit a super mutant leader. Can only be worn by Super Mutants.

ThingDef.label: Swan's rusted ship anchor
ThingDef.description: A massive, barnacle-encrusted iron ship anchor ripped from a sunken hull and wielded as a devastating two-handed club. Too heavy (18 kg) for ordinary humans—can only be wielded by Super Mutants or soldiers wearing Power Armor.

ThingDef.label: Alpha Vampire's ancient cloak
ThingDef.description: A regal, floor-length obsidian silk and leather cloak lined with dark crimson velvet, radiating ancient predatory authority.

ThingDef.label: Dick Roman's billionaire suit
ThingDef.description: An ultra-expensive navy-blue bespoke corporate suit with a crisp white shirt and silk tie, exuding ruthless executive power.
